title: Carrots by the Millimetre  (按毫米切的胡萝卜)

segments.t: 星期三上午十点，烤箱里的面包已经烤得金黄。凯勒布站在泰莎和欧文旁边的案板前，面前摆着切得整整齐齐的胡萝卜和洋葱。先完整听一遍吧。
Look at Caleb's cutting board, Tessa: every carrot cube is identical!
Even cubes cook at the exact same speed, brother. Basic physics!
Laugh all you want, Owen, that is the neatest soup prep my kitchen has ever seen!
Pot is warm with olive oil. Onions and carrots going in now?
Yes! Stir three minutes until sweet, then add red lentils and hot broth.
Need the courtyard thyme and parsley next, Chef?
Two fresh sprigs tied with string, plus one pinch of salt at the end.
Listening to soup simmer in a stone kitchen beats city traffic any day.
Funny: three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we make soup together.
Remind me never to wait three years to call you again, Owen.
All right, brothers, save the tears. My bread timer is ringing!
Oven mitts on! Eight crusty loaves coming out hot!
现在，让我们仔细听听厨房里的这番对话。
Look at Caleb's cutting board, Tessa: every carrot cube is identical!
「看看凯勒布的案板，泰莎：每一个胡萝卜丁都一模一样！」 厨师必备的工具，这两个词在日常使用中已经完美结合：
cutting board
字面意思就是“用来切东西的板子”。
Even cubes cook at the exact same speed, brother. Basic physics!
「均匀的碎丁烹饪的速度完全一样，哥哥。这是基础物理学！」 除了作为数字的“偶数”，这个词作为形容词放在名词前面时，
Even cubes
描述的是形状均匀、大小相同的块状。
Laugh all you want, Owen, that is the neatest soup prep my kitchen has ever seen!
「随你怎么笑，欧文，这是我的厨房见过的最整洁的煮汤准备工作！」 泰莎用这种带着笑意的让步语气说：
Laugh all you want
意思是随他怎么开玩笑，她还是赞同凯勒布的做法。
Pot is warm with olive oil. Onions and carrots going in now?
「锅里的橄榄油热了。现在放洋葱和胡萝卜吗？」 在厨房快节奏的对话中，这里省略了助动词来提问，
going in now
意思就是“我现在把它们放进锅里吗？”
Yes! Stir three minutes until sweet, then add red lentils and hot broth.
「对！翻炒三分钟直到变甜，然后加入红扁豆和热高汤。」 这种脱了皮、呈橘红色、在汤里煮熟后很容易变软的豆子叫做
red lentils
在做浓汤时非常受欢迎。
Need the courtyard thyme and parsley next, Chef?
「接下来需要庭院里的百里香和欧芹吗，主厨？」 注意拼写和发音：这种香草的名字
thyme
里面的字母 h 不发音，整个词和 time（时间）的发音完全一样。
Two fresh sprigs tied with string, plus one pinch of salt at the end.
「两根用绳子捆起来的新鲜小枝，最后再加一撮盐。」 一句话里包含了两个经典的厨房计量单位：
Two fresh sprigs
用来量细嫩的香草枝条，而
one pinch of salt
则是指我们用指尖捏起的那一点点分量。
Listening to soup simmer in a stone kitchen beats city traffic any day.
「听着汤在石头厨房里慢慢炖的声音，无论什么时候都胜过城市的交通噪音。」 在日常对话中非常有表现力，动词 beat 在这里
beats city traffic any day
表示厨房里的宁静“彻底击败”了城市的喧嚣。
Funny: three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we make soup together.
「挺好笑的：三年前我们在电话里吵架，今天我们一起做汤。」 注意在英语里使用电话时的介词：他们总是说在电话线“上”交流，用的是
on the phone
而我们中文里习惯说“在”电话里，或者“通过”电话。
Remind me never to wait three years to call you again, Owen.
「提醒我以后永远不要再等三年才给你打电话，欧文。」 别把“自己记住”（remember）和“提醒别人”混淆了：
Remind me never to wait
这个结构是动词加上人称，再接 to 或者 never to。
All right, brothers, save the tears. My bread timer is ringing!
「好了，兄弟们，把眼泪收起来吧。我的烤面包计时器在响了！」 泰莎为了打破这温柔的感伤时刻，开玩笑地说：
save the tears
意思是让他们控制住情绪，因为面包已经烤好了。
Oven mitts on! Eight crusty loaves coming out hot!
「戴上烤箱手套！八个外壳酥脆的面包热腾腾地出炉啦！」 注意名词 loaf 在这里的不规则复数形式，以 -ves 结尾：
Eight crusty loaves
刚从石头烤箱里烤成金黄色的面包。让我们伴着庭院香草的芬芳，再听一遍整个场景吧。
Look at Caleb's cutting board, Tessa: every carrot cube is identical!
Even cubes cook at the exact same speed, brother. Basic physics!
Laugh all you want, Owen, that is the neatest soup prep my kitchen has ever seen!
Pot is warm with olive oil. Onions and carrots going in now?
Yes! Stir three minutes until sweet, then add red lentils and hot broth.
Need the courtyard thyme and parsley next, Chef?
Two fresh sprigs tied with string, plus one pinch of salt at the end.
Listening to soup simmer in a stone kitchen beats city traffic any day.
Funny: three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we make soup together.
Remind me never to wait three years to call you again, Owen.
All right, brothers, save the tears. My bread timer is ringing!
Oven mitts on! Eight crusty loaves coming out hot!
金黄的面包从烤箱里拿出来，散发着香味的扁豆汤在炉子上炖着，兄弟俩并肩工作着。我们下个场景见！
See you later!
